lines.zh: 我拖着长长的手臂走在陆地上。
lines.en: I walk on land, my long arms trailing.

lines.zh: 甲壳相碰，像有人在敲钟。
lines.en: My plates clang like a struck bell.

lines.zh: 深溟的痕，我一路都认得。
lines.en: I know every trace of the deep sea.
The grass blackens where my feet touch.
I am the guide. Walk behind me.

lines.zh: 潮水记在我身上，我顺着潮走。
lines.en: The tide is written in me. I follow it.
Each step leaves a slick mark.

lines.zh: 我抬起手臂，又慢慢放下。
lines.en: I raise an arm, then let it fall slowly.

lines.zh: 我绕着圈子，想把路走成一个环。
lines.en: I circle, trying to make the path a ring.

lines.zh: 海在很远的地方涨，我知道。
lines.en: The sea is rising far away. I know.

lines.zh: 我走向水里，脚一沾就滑。
lines.en: I head for the water; my feet slip into it.

lines.zh: 深海的路，我走过很多回。
lines.en: I've walked the deep-sea road many times.

lines.zh: 不急着到，路要一步步量。
lines.en: No hurry. The road must be measured step by step.

lines.zh: 我停下来，确认方向没错。
lines.en: I stop to confirm the direction is right.
The edge of my shell scrapes the stone.

lines.zh: 我带着咸味，风都跟着湿。
lines.en: I carry salt; even the wind turns damp.
I stand straight as a stele.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，盐霜结在肩。
lines.en: I stand still; salt frost forms on my shoulders.

lines.zh: 深海的水压，一直推着我。
lines.en: Deep-sea pressure keeps pushing at me.

lines.zh: 背上那些管状的东西，会张开。
lines.en: The tubes along my back open and close.
Too dry here. I'm stiffening.
I count the tides. Twice a day.

lines.zh: 这壳不是天生的，是长出来的。
lines.en: This shell wasn't given. It grew.

lines.zh: 我什么都不做，也是一种引领。
lines.en: Doing nothing is also a kind of leading.
Salt on the wind. I smell it.
I am waiting for my kin to catch up.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只手臂，让它垂着。
lines.en: I lift an arm and let it hang.

lines.zh: 身体里有什么在慢慢移。
lines.en: Something shifts slowly inside me.
At night the sea is loudest.
I don't sleep. I don't need to.
The water on you hasn't dried.
I look at you the way I'd look at a road.
Follow my tendrils and don't stop.
You carry the sea on you.

lines.zh: 我可以告诉你该往哪里去。
lines.en: I can tell you where to go.
Don't stand square in front of me.

lines.zh: 你这么小，潮水会淹没你。
lines.en: You're small. The tide will cover you.
You're hesitating. I see it.
I won't hurt you unless you block the way.

lines.zh: 你脚下已经是我的路了。
lines.en: The ground you stand on is already my road.

lines.zh: 深海韧皮翻开，露出白肉。
lines.en: My deep-sea bark splits, showing white flesh.

lines.zh: 水从伤口流出来，止不住。
lines.en: Water pours from the wound and won't stop.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，这条路让给你。
lines.en: I take a step back. The road is yours.
This wound will harden into new shell.
I shudder and return to my place.
Pain is a feeling I haven't had in a while.
You broke my sense of direction.

lines.zh: 我扶住旁边的树，慢慢站稳。
lines.en: I brace on a tree and steady myself.
My blood is salt, like seawater.

lines.zh: 别急，我还没走完这条路。
lines.en: Not yet. I haven't finished this road.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，是活的吗？
lines.en: Is the thing in your hand alive?
I smell what's in the water.
I reach out only to check.

lines.zh: 这东西能让我长得更快。
lines.en: This will make me grow faster.

lines.zh: 你放在地上，我自己来取。
lines.en: Set it down. I'll take it myself.
I won't eat it. I'll carry it.

lines.zh: 这气味，跟深海的不一样。
lines.en: This smells different from the deep.
I approach slowly. Don't panic.
Keep your hand steady or it'll spill.

lines.zh: 你把食物放下，我记住石头。
lines.en: Leave the food; I will remember the stone.
You struck my shell. Hard, isn't it.
My arm has come to rest on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我的甲壳擦过你，留下湿印。
lines.en: My shell brushes you, leaving a wet mark.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，你身上湿了。
lines.en: We collided, and now you're wet.

lines.zh: 我这条手臂比看起来重。
lines.en: This arm is heavier than it looks.

lines.zh: 我二十四格内，没有藏身处。
lines.en: Within twenty-four blocks, nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 碰过我的地方，会留下痕。
lines.en: Where you touched me, a mark remains.
Don't crowd me. The path is narrow.

lines.zh: 别慌，我的手臂比桅杆粗。
lines.en: Steady. My arm is thicker than a mast.
You stepped on my arm.
My kind doesn't rely on that.
Come closer. Let me look at you.

lines.zh: 你身上还没有海的味道。
lines.en: You don't yet smell of the sea.
Wait until the tide comes.
This isn't affection. It's a mark.
I'll remember the sound of your breathing.
Stay with me and we won't be separated.
I'll walk this road with you twice.
Sooner or later, you'll become one of us.
Don't fear. The tide is gentle.
I coil an arm around it.
The sea brought these.

lines.zh: 我要把它们摆成一个圈。
lines.en: I'll arrange them in a ring.
I pick it up and squeeze it.
Too heavy. Two trips.
It stuck to my hand on its own.
This one is for my kin.
I'll leave it here as a marker.
You dropped it. I return it.

lines.zh: 这些东西，陆地上很少见。
lines.en: These are rare on land.

lines.zh: 你走到了不该走的地方。
lines.en: You walked where you shouldn't.
I've fixed on your scent.
This road ends at you.
I dislike being blocked.
You're running. You won't get far.
The tide will catch you.
I raise my arm. This is guidance.

lines.zh: 我循着你的脚印，找到这里。
lines.en: I followed your tracks to this place.
My kin wait on the other side.
This road is mine to decide.

lines.zh: 我引着海潮，追上你的脚步。
lines.en: I lead the tide to catch your steps.
Where you walk, the road grows.

lines.zh: 你脚步的间隔，我数得清。
lines.en: I can count the gaps between your steps.
Look back. I'm still here.
You're getting deeper.

lines.zh: 整片浅滩都在替我看路。
lines.en: The whole shallows watches the path for me.
There's no exit ahead. I know.

lines.zh: 深海韧皮护着我，过来试。
lines.en: Deep-sea hide shields me. Try it.
The grass you walked over has blackened.
A little further and we reach the sea.
My arm swings down like a hammer.

lines.zh: 我抬手一压，你陷进滩涂。
lines.en: One push of my hand and you sink into the mudflat.

lines.zh: 这一下，是为了让你停下。
lines.en: This is to make you stop.
The rim of my shell is sharp.
I charge, my weight bearing down.
You shouldn't have stepped over that line.

lines.zh: 我打得很慢，但停不下来。
lines.en: My blows are slow, but they don't stop.
My arm coils around your leg.
I told you not to block the way.
After this, you'll understand.
I appear in the tide first.

lines.zh: 水从我的甲缝里流出来。
lines.en: Water runs from the seams of my shell.

lines.zh: 我踏上陆地，地面就湿了。
lines.en: I step onto land and the ground turns wet.
The guide has come.
I come from the sea's direction.

lines.zh: 我站定，先看了一遍地势。
lines.en: I stand and survey the terrain.
This place will be flooded eventually.
I raise an arm, pointing inland.

lines.zh: 盐在我身上结了一层白。
lines.en: Salt has crusted white on my body.

lines.zh: 同伴会跟着我的痕走过来。
lines.en: My kin will follow my marks here.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的甲，裂得更快。
lines.en: Fire bakes my shell; the cracks spread faster.

lines.zh: 我从高处坠下来，甲片碎了。
lines.en: I fell from height and plates shattered.
Water floods in, and I feel oddly calm.
The blast flung me a long way.
Something shot through a seam in my shell.
This light is burning the sea in me.

lines.zh: 太久没回到水里，我在干。
lines.en: Too long out of water. I'm drying out.

lines.zh: 雷落在甲上，我整片麻了。
lines.en: Lightning struck my shell; all of me went numb.
No sea here. No road either.
